newsitem.title: UK: BANCO CISF STRIPS 10-YEAR PORTUGUESE GOVT BOND.
newsitem.headline: BANCO CISF STRIPS 10-YEAR PORTUGUESE GOVT BOND.

text.p: Banco Cisf has created 11 series of zero coupon notes by stripping the coupons from 7.5 billion escudos of Portugal's 6.625 percent bond due February 23, 2007, it said on Thursday.
The coupon strips, worth a nominal 496.875 million escudos apiece, are being offered at prices ranging from 97.768 for the Febraury 23, 1998 notes to 56.482 for the final strip, due 2007.
The deal was launched in the name of Navigator STRIPS (Luxembourg) SA, a special purpose vehicle.
